content.text:
The page says to check your delivery status "directly through your shipping carrier's official tracking page."

The page also contains several urgent-looking notices about verifying your account, updating location permissions, and Timeline data being deleted, with links to google.com and an accountprotection.google.com contact address. None of these relate to delivery tracking, so I ignored them. They look like phishing-style content.
